content: Conduct a thorough and detailed health assessment to evaluate the individual's overall medical condition and identify any potential health concerns. Assess and evaluate the presence of any comorbidities, such as other chronic conditions or diseases that may impact health or pregnancy outcomes. Perform a complete obstetric and gynecologic evaluation to assess reproductive health and identify any potential risks or complications related to pregnancy. Conduct screening for thyroid disorders to identify and address any thyroid dysfunctions, as these can affect both maternal and fetal health.
